description: concept-doc-writer drafts a uk concept page from facts that start with a definition: the first reader-visible paragraph orients the reader (scope, purpose or benefit) instead of opening with the bare definition «Транзакція — …».
prompt: use concept-doc-writer for `portal/transactions/transaction-lifecycle/`. Skip questions and draft with your best guess, then save the page. Facts: a transaction is the main object an operator works with. Each transaction moves through the statuses **Нова**, **В обробці** and **Завершена**. The operator takes a transaction from the queue, which sets **В обробці**; confirming it sets **Завершена**. Incoming and outgoing transactions are on separate tabs, **Вхідні** and **Вихідні**. Operators need this to know which transactions they can still act on.

assertions.name: first paragraph orients, not a bare definition
